name: Er ge (Chinese children’s repertoire)
lineage: pichia — 小毛驢, complete four-page solo-piano theme and three variations. Arranger pichia publishes a complete four-page solo-piano adaptation of 小毛驢(Xiao Mao Lu/Little Donkey), including its theme and three variations labeled tango, Latin and waltz. Public arranger description explicitly calls the repertoire er ge/children song, specifies solo piano, printed lyrics and chords, C major and an Overture-generated listening example. Variations have no lyrics. Complete arrangement metadata was read; purchased full score and audio were not accessed. No original choir recording instrumentation is inferred from the piano edition. The selected published arrangement is explicitly piano solo despite printed lyrics; no singer is added. One nine-foot Steinway-D grand with conventional matching construction and block-chord song support is an authored physical realization, not the arranger playback piano model or source recording equipment. Broad functionalSong models the familiar song-theme and chordal dance variations, rather than treating notation alone as classical art music. Global tuning omitted; source C-major key is retained in evidence but does not prove a measured temperament. Studio capture choices are editorial.
recipe: classic er ge, functional Song. soft felt lacquer voiced 17 ply hard rock maple sitka spruce grand piano. treated studio. small-diaphragm pencil condenser, transformerless solid-state pre. 24-bit digital.
